mapper.sql: r.id, r.role_id, r.code, r.name, r.description, r.status, r.built_in, r.version, r.applied_version, r.create_time, r.last_update_time

where.if: AND (r.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR r.code ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.sql: SELECT u.user_id::text AS user_id, u.username, u.display_name, u.phone, u.rbac_version AS version, u.last_update_time, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM squad_user.sq_user_role a WHERE a.user_id = u.user_id) THEN 'UNASSIGNED' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM squad_user.sq_user_role a WHERE a.user_id = u.user_id AND a.status = 'ACTIVE') THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'DISABLED' END AS status, COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(r.name, '、' ORDER BY r.code) FROM squad_user.sq_user_role a JOIN squad_user.sq_role r ON r.role_id = a.role_id WHERE a.user_id = u.user_id), '') AS role_names FROM squad_user.sq_user u

WHERE u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND (u.username ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR u.display_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR u.phone ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM squad_user.sq_user_role a WHERE a.user_id = u.user_id)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM squad_user.sq_user_role a WHERE a.user_id = u.user_id AND a.status = 'ACTIVE')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM squad_user.sq_user_role a WHERE a.user_id = u.user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM squad_user.sq_user_role a WHERE a.user_id = u.user_id AND a.status = 'ACTIVE')

where.if: AND (code ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE valid_menu AS ( SELECT rm.role_id, m.menu_id FROM squad_user.sq_role_menu rm JOIN squad_user.sq_menu m ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id WHERE rm.stage = 'APPLIED' AND m.parent_menu_id IS NULL AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT rm.role_id, m.menu_id FROM squad_user.sq_role_menu rm JOIN squad_user.sq_menu m ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN valid_menu parent ON parent.role_id = rm.role_id AND parent.menu_id = m.parent_menu_id WHERE rm.stage = 'APPLIED' ) SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM squad_user.sq_user u JOIN squad_user.sq_user_role a ON a.user_id = u.user_id AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN squad_user.sq_role r ON r.role_id = a.role_id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.applied_version IS NOT NULL JOIN squad_user.sq_role_permission p ON p.role_id = r.role_id AND p.stage = 'APPLIED' JOIN squad_user.sq_permission f ON f.code = p.permission_code AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN valid_menu m ON m.role_id = r.role_id AND m.menu_id = f.menu_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY p.permission_code
SELECT version FROM squad_user.sq_rbac_revision WHERE code = 'authorization'
mapper.update: UPDATE squad_user.sq_rbac_revision SET version = version + 1, last_updater_id = #{actor}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE code = 'authorization' AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM squad_user.sq_role r WHERE r.applied_version IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.code
SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM squad_user.sq_user_role a WHERE a.role_id = r.role_id) AS member_count FROM squad_user.sq_role r WHERE r.role_id = #{roleId}

SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM squad_user.sq_user_role a WHERE a.role_id = r.role_id) AS member_count FROM squad_user.sq_role r
ORDER BY r.built_in DESC, r.create_time DESC, r.role_id LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT code, name, module, description FROM squad_user.sq_permission ORDER BY code LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{offset}
ORDER BY u.user_id DESC LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{offset}
WHERE u.phone = #{phone} AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT role_id FROM squad_user.sq_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY role_id
SELECT code FROM squad_user.sq_permission ORDER BY code
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM squad_user.sq_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND stage = #{stage}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO squad_user.sq_role_permission (role_id, permission_code, stage, creator_id, last_updater_id) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{code}, #{stage}, #{actor}, #{actor})
mapper.update: UPDATE squad_user.sq_role SET name = #{role.name}, description = #{role.description}, version = version + 1, last_updater_id = #{actor}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE role_id = #{role.roleId} AND version = #{role.version}
UPDATE squad_user.sq_role SET applied_version = version + 1, version = version + 1, status = 'ACTIVE', last_updater_id = #{actor}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE role_id = #{roleId}

UPDATE squad_user.sq_role SET applied_version = CASE WHEN applied_version = version THEN version + 1 ELSE applied_version END, status = #{status}, version = version + 1, last_updater_id = #{actor}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO squad_user.sq_user_role (user_id, role_id, status, creator_id, last_updater_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, #{status}, #{actor}, #{actor})
mapper.update: UPDATE squad_user.sq_user_role SET status = #{status}, last_updater_id = #{actor}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO squad_user.sq_rbac_log (operation, target_id, summary, creator_id) VALUES (#{operation}, #{targetId}, #{summary}, #{actor})
